categories.description: Pricing set as cost plus a percentage of cost, or a percentage of construction cost — a contracting method federal procurement rules prohibit outright.
categories.name: Cost-Plus-Percentage Pricing

categories.description: A clause limiting, conditioning, or charging for access to the vendor's records, or resisting audit by the district, state, or federal awarding agency.
categories.name: Audit / Records Access Restriction

categories.description: A vendor right over student or district data — ownership claims, use for marketing or product development, sale or sharing with third parties, or survival of data rights after termination.
categories.name: Student Data Rights

categories.description: A clause restricting the district's right to terminate — early termination fees, long notice periods, no termination for convenience, or penalties on exit.
categories.name: Termination Restriction

categories.description: An obligation on the district to indemnify, defend, or hold harmless the vendor — public entities are rarely permitted to give open-ended indemnities.
categories.name: Indemnity Given by District

categories.description: Language making the vendor an exclusive provider, restricting competitive procurement, or locking future purchases to this vendor.
categories.name: Sole-Source / Exclusivity

categories.description: A contract term, minimum commitment, or payment obligation extending beyond a stated grant or budget period.
categories.name: Term Beyond Grant Period

categories.description: An uncapped or formula-based price increase — annual uplifts, index-linked increases, or renegotiation rights on renewal.
categories.name: Price Escalation

categories.description: An evergreen or automatic renewal clause, and the notice window required to stop it.
categories.name: Automatic Renewal

categories.description: A vendor disclaimer of warranties or exclusion of liability that leaves the district without remedy for non-performance.
categories.name: Warranty / Liability Disclaimer

categories.description: A vendor right to assign or subcontract the contract without the district's consent.
categories.name: Unrestricted Assignment

categories.description: The jurisdiction whose law governs the contract, and any venue or forum clause moving disputes away from the district's home jurisdiction.
categories.name: Governing Law

classify_context: You are triaging one document from a school district's procurement file against a grant-compliance document list. Read the excerpt and decide which single document type it is. US public-sector procurement context.

document_types.description: A request for proposals, invitation to bid, quote request, or other competitive solicitation document.
document_types.name: Solicitation / RFP Documents

document_types.description: The principal services or goods agreement with a vendor — master agreement, services contract, or supply agreement.
document_types.name: Vendor Services Agreement

document_types.description: A software licence, SaaS subscription, or educational technology platform agreement, including click-through or order-form terms.
document_types.name: Software / EdTech Agreement

document_types.description: A student-data privacy agreement, data processing addendum, or privacy rider governing pupil or district data.
document_types.name: Data Privacy Agreement

document_types.description: A purchase order, order form, or statement of work issued under a master agreement.
document_types.name: Purchase Orders

document_types.description: Board minutes, resolutions, or consent agendas approving the procurement or contract award.
document_types.name: Board Approval / Minutes

document_types.description: A written justification for a noncompetitive or sole-source award.
document_types.name: Sole-Source Justification

document_types.description: Certificates of insurance, coverage schedules, or bonding documents for a vendor.
document_types.name: Insurance Certificates

document_types.description: Construction, renovation, maintenance, or facilities services agreements.
document_types.name: Facilities / Construction Contracts

document_types.description: Student transportation, food service, custodial, or other operational services agreements.
document_types.name: Transportation / Food / Operations
